title: Hope in conflict on the cover of Apollon
originalTitle: Israel og Palestina: Håpets paradoks i en fastlåst konflikt
author: Ingrid Bjerknes Røyne
description: Our research on hope in conflict is featured on the cover of issue 4/2026 of Apollon, the University of Oslo’s research magazine. In interviews with Maor Shani and Jonas R. Kunst, the article explores our paper, Between victory and peace, and why the outcomes people hope for matter.
summary: Drawing on four survey studies in the Israeli–Palestinian and India–Pakistan conflict contexts, the article distinguishes hope for peace, associated with willingness to compromise, from hope for victory, associated with support for extreme war policies and violent intentions. Many participants hoped for both. These dual hopers supported more confrontational policies than those who primarily hoped for peace, yet generally preferred peace when asked to choose. The discussion also considers threat, group identity, and how people imagine a future of security and peace.
homepageSummary: The University of Oslo’s research magazine features our work on hope for peace and victory on the cover of its new issue. Read an English summary of the Norwegian interview with Maor Shani and Jonas R. Kunst.
verification: Article read on 2 November 2026; cover placement confirmed by Maor Shani.
